fico.title: Course Completion Certificate in SAP FICO
fico.description: Once you've finished all 12 modules, cleared the module-level assessments, and completed the capstone project, you'll get a Course Completion Certificate in SAP FICO.
highlights: You've worked hands-on on a live SAP S/4HANA system — this isn't a "watched the videos" certificate
You've been through the full curriculum, module by module
You've delivered a real capstone project, the kind you can walk an interviewer through
fico.note: This is a training completion certificate, not SAP's official certification. If you want to pursue SAP's own certification exam later, we'll point you in the right direction, but that's a separate process with its own cost and exam.

mm.title: SAP MM Course Completion Certificate
mm.description: Upon successful completion of the course and project work, you will receive the following:
highlights: Course Completion Certificate — recognized by hiring partners and industry
Certificate valid for LinkedIn, resume, and job applications
Optional guidance for SAP Global Certification (C_TS410 / MM Certification) exam registration
Real-time project experience letter (for eligible batches)
mm.note: This is an institute-issued training certificate. Official SAP certification is a separate exam conducted by SAP.

hrhcm.title: SAP HCM Course Completion Certificate
hrhcm.description: You'll receive a Course Completion Certificate once you finish the syllabus and the final project simulation. It's not handed out just for attendance — you'll need to demonstrate configuration work and clear a short practical assessment.
highlights: Supports your resume and LinkedIn profile
Based on demonstrated configuration work and practical assessment
Prepares you to talk through configuration decisions in interviews
hrhcm.note: The certificate is meant to support your resume and LinkedIn profile, not replace real project experience. If you're aiming for a formal SAP certification (via SAP's own certification exams), we can guide you on that separate path and how this course maps to it.

qm.title: SAP QM Course Completion Certificate
qm.description: You'll get a Course Completion Certificate once you finish the training and submit your final project — this is proof of practical, hands-on SAP QM training, useful for your resume and LinkedIn profile.
highlights: Proof of practical, hands-on SAP QM training
Useful for resume and LinkedIn profile
Guidance on the official SAP Certification path if you want to pursue it separately
qm.note: We'll also guide you on the official SAP Certification path if you want to pursue it separately through SAP's certification hub — including what to expect, how to prepare, and whether it's actually worth it for your specific career stage (we'll give you an honest answer, not a sales pitch).

ps.title: SAP PS Course Completion Certificate
ps.description: On completing the course — including the assignments and the final project simulation — you'll receive a Course Completion Certificate.
highlights: Modules covered and hours completed
The final project/case study you worked on
Your instructor's sign-off on practical competency
ps.note: This is an institute completion certificate, not an SAP SE certification. If you're also targeting an official SAP certification, we'll guide you on which exam to consider and how this course maps to its syllabus — but the exam itself is booked and taken separately with SAP. The certificate is meant to support your resume and LinkedIn profile, and we're happy to verify it for any employer who reaches out.

scm.title: SAP SCM Course Completion Certificate
scm.description: On completing the course, you'll receive a Course Completion Certificate which reflects the modules covered, duration, and hands-on project work completed.
highlights: Modules covered (MM, SD, PP, and integration scenarios)
Duration and hands-on project work completed
Training track (classroom / online)
scm.note: This is an institute-issued training certificate, not an official SAP-certified credential. If you want the official SAP Certified Associate certification, that's a separate exam conducted directly by SAP, and we'll guide you on how to prepare for and register for it if you choose to pursue it after this course.

ehs.title: SAP EHS Course Completion Certificate
ehs.description: You'll receive a Course Completion Certificate on finishing the program, which includes your project work and assessment scores. This certificate is recognized by our hiring partners and is commonly accepted as proof of practical SAP EHS training during interviews.
highlights: Includes project work and assessment scores
Recognized by hiring partners
Accepted as proof of practical SAP EHS training during interviews
ehs.note: For those who want a formal SAP-recognized credential, we'll also guide you on the official SAP Certification exam path — including how to register, what it costs, and how our curriculum maps to the certification syllabus. (This exam is separate and conducted directly by SAP; our course prepares you for it but the certification itself is issued by SAP.)

ibp.title: SAP IBP Course Completion Certificate
ibp.description: On successful completion of the SAP IBP course, you will receive a course completion certificate that validates your practical training and project work. This certificate is recognized by training partners and hiring companies across Mumbai and helps strengthen your profile during job applications and interviews.
highlights: Validates practical training and project work
Recognized by training partners and hiring companies across Mumbai
Strengthens your profile during job applications and interviews
ibp.note: For those aiming for official SAP credentials, our trainers also guide you through the SAP IBP certification exam pattern, sample questions, and preparation strategy, so you're fully ready to appear for the global SAP certification if you choose to pursue it.

ariba.title: SAP Ariba Course Completion Certificate
ariba.description: Once you complete the course — including the capstone project — you'll receive a Course Completion Certificate from Connecting Dots ERP.
highlights: Includes the modules covered, project details, and duration
Something you can genuinely reference on your resume and in interviews
Backed by your capstone project as proof of work
ariba.note: This is an institute-issued completion certificate, not an official SAP certification. If you're aiming for SAP's own certification exam, we'll guide you on how to prepare for that separately. What actually matters to employers is that you can demonstrate real, hands-on understanding of Ariba — which is exactly what this course is built to give you.

sd.title: SAP SD Course Completion Certificate
sd.description: On completing the course, you'll receive a Course Completion Certificate that verifies the modules and topics covered, total training hours completed, and hands-on project work completed on the live server.
highlights: Modules and topics covered
Total training hours completed
Hands-on project work completed on the live server
sd.note: This is an institute-issued training certificate, not an official SAP certification. If you're aiming for SAP's own certification (through SAP's certification hub), we'll guide you on how to prepare for it separately. We're upfront about this distinction because a lot of institutes blur the line, and we'd rather you know exactly what you're getting.

pp.title: SAP PP Course Completion Certificate
pp.description: Upon successful completion of this SAP PP training, you will receive a Course Completion Certificate that validates your practical, hands-on experience with SAP Production Planning.
highlights: Modules and topics covered during training
Practical project work completed
Duration and mode of training (classroom/online)
Guidance and mock tests for official SAP Certification exams
Interview-ready project documentation to showcase to employers
pp.note: Additionally, we help you prepare for official SAP Certification exams and interview-ready project documentation.

pm.title: SAP PM Course Completion Certificate
pm.description: On successful completion of the course, you will receive an industry-recognised SAP PM Course Completion Certificate, which validates your practical skills in Plant Maintenance configuration and real-time project handling.
highlights: Certificate issued after project submission and final assessment
Includes hands-on project experience documentation for your resume/LinkedIn
Optional guidance provided for SAP Global Certification exam registration
Verifiable certificate with unique ID for employer validation
pm.note: This certificate, combined with the practical exposure gained during training, gives you a strong edge when applying for SAP PM functional consultant roles in Mumbai and beyond.

ewm.title: Certificate of Completion in SAP EWM
ewm.description: On successful completion of the course, you will receive a Certificate of Completion in SAP EWM, recognising the modules covered, hours of training completed, and the hands-on project work undertaken during the course.
highlights: Modules covered and hours of training completed
Hands-on project work undertaken
Strengthens your resume and LinkedIn profile
Supports applications for SAP EWM consultant, warehouse analyst, or supply chain executive roles
ewm.note: Certification is awarded based on attendance, assignment completion, and a final practical assessment covering the topics taught during the program.

btp.title: SAP BTP Course Completion Certificate
btp.description: On successful completion of this SAP BTP training in Mumbai, you will receive a Course Completion Certificate that validates your hands-on training, project work, and assessment performance.
highlights: Successful completion of all curriculum modules
Hands-on project submission and evaluation
Attendance and participation in live sessions
btp.note: Additionally, our trainers guide you through the process of preparing for and registering for the official SAP BTP certification exam. Certification requirements, exam codes, and fees are governed directly by SAP and are shared transparently during the course.

grc.title: SAP GRC Course Completion Certificate
grc.description: On successful completion of this SAP GRC course in Mumbai, you will receive a course completion certificate recognized by hiring partners across Mumbai and India.
highlights: Course completion certificate recognized by hiring partners
Detailed skills scorecard covering Access Control, Process Control, and Risk Management
Project completion certificates for hands-on assignments
Guidance and study material for the official SAP GRC certification exam
grc.note: Our certificate reflects real, hands-on competency — not just classroom attendance — which is why it holds value with recruiters and SAP implementation partners.

successfactors.title: SAP SuccessFactors Course Completion Certificate
successfactors.description: On successful completion of this SAP SuccessFactors course in Mumbai, you will receive a course completion certificate that validates your practical training and project work.
highlights: Confirms hands-on training across all core SAP SF modules
Validates completion of the real-time mock project
Recognized by our placement and hiring partners in Mumbai
Useful supporting document alongside official SAP certification exams
successfactors.note: The certificate validates your practical training and project work and is recognized by our placement and hiring partners in Mumbai.

abap.title: SAP ABAP Course Completion Certificate
abap.description: On successful completion of the course, you will receive a Course Completion Certificate recognized by SAP consulting and IT companies.
highlights: Modules covered and hours of training completed
Practical project work completed on live SAP systems
Assessment performance and skill validation
abap.note: For those aiming for a formal SAP credential, our trainers also guide you on preparing for SAP's official certification exams, including exam pattern, question types, and study resources.

hana.title: SAP S/4HANA Course Completion Certificate
hana.description: On successful completion of the course — including the capstone project and final assessment — you will receive a Course Completion Certificate that verifies your hands-on training in SAP S/4HANA.
highlights: Module(s) completed (Finance, MM, SD, or PP)
Total training hours completed
Practical project work undertaken
Assessment performance
hana.note: This certificate verifies your hands-on training in SAP S/4HANA including the capstone project and final assessment.

bwbi.title: SAP BW/BI Course Completion Certificate
bwbi.description: On successful completion of the SAP BW/BI course in Mumbai, you will receive a course completion certificate that reflects the hands-on modules, project work, and assessments you've completed.
highlights: Hands-on modules completed
Project work and assessments completed
Designed to strengthen your resume and demonstrate practical, project-ready SAP BW/BI skills
bwbi.note: For learners who wish to go further, our trainers also guide you on preparing for official SAP global certification exams, including exam pattern, study material direction, and mock assessments.

basis.title: SAP Basis Course Completion Certificate
basis.description: On successful completion of the course and the final hands-on assessment, you'll receive a Course Completion Certificate that verifies your training in SAP Basis administration.
highlights: Certificate reflects the modules covered and hours of hands-on lab work completed
Useful as supporting proof of skill during job applications and interviews
Issued after evaluation of your practical lab exercises and a final project
Digital copy provided, with physical certificate available on request
basis.note: We're upfront about one thing: a certificate alone doesn't get you a job — the practical skill behind it does. That's why our program leans so heavily on labs, tickets, and mock scenarios rather than just classroom hours.
